idea-plugin.name: Git Commit Template
idea-plugin.description:
Create a commit message with the following template:

        <type>(<scope>): <subject>
        <BLANK LINE>
        <body>
        <BLANK LINE>
        <footer>

I really like using this submission template plug-in, but the original project has stopped being maintained, so I cloned it and made modifications. Welcome to use it!

Current project link
Original project link
FAQ Page
Submit Issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
V260102-0123

1. Fixed UI anomalies caused by coroutine context conflicts. Issue #20

V251209-1422

1. A type conversion error occurred in the commit message editing window of Squish commits, causing the main functionality of the plugin to fail to load and display correctly. Issue #19

V250503-1202

1. Fixed the error that the position of multiple monitors exceeds the visible range Issue #17

2. Optimized Git submission template to support optional configuration of Scope Issue #16

V250326-2342

1. Added a settings interface. You can go to "Settings > Tools > Commit Template Idea Plugin" to customize the settings.

2. Added Git submission template customization function to adjust the template content according to needs.

3. Added Gitmoji support to add some fun emojis to your commits. To turn on the Gitmoji option, you can go to the "Git > Log" panel, click the "eye" icon -> Show columns -> Gitmoji to show/hide columns and view emojis in the extended column.

4. Added shortcut key support, now you can use "Alt + Shift + Q" to call up the submission panel

5. Please note that Gitmoji relies on IDEA's experimental API, which may be abandoned in the future depending on the version, causing the plugin to fail.

V250227-1438

1. Breaking update: Refactored the project pop-up window business to provide support for English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Canadian French, German, Italian, Japanese, and Korean. (Note: Language translation is processed using Google Translate, there may be grammatical errors, translation errors, etc. If you encounter any problems, please contact me (email: muzi@muzilib.com))

2. Highlights: Supports recording window position and size, which is more in line with user habits

3. Fix the Chinese garbled error in the multi-line text input box Issue #7

4. Stop supporting gitmoji input Issue #4

V240630-2210

1. Add support for gitmoji

V240604-2259

1. Remove the dependency on the com.intellij.modules.vcs module

V240407-1343

1. Fix the error of failure to generate template if the Scope of this change parameter is empty Issue #3

2. To add support for the Chinese language, you can install the plug-in Chinese ​(Simplified)​ Language Pack / 中文语言包 to gain support

V240302-0007

1. Fixed bug regarding character related methods being removed

V240125-1229

1. Fixed the problem of not being able to be used on IDEA2023.3.2(233), now let’s use it happily!
